# Third-party notices

The third-party crates that may end up in a binary this repository ships, and their
licences. The list is the union of `cargo tree --workspace -e normal --all-features`
run for two targets (`x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`), with
this workspace's own crates excluded. Build-only and dev-only dependencies are not
here, because they are not in what ships (`-e normal`).

The licence policy is enforced by `deny.toml` and `deps.allow`; how a dependency is
approved is in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Assets

Assets are not crates, so they are outside `cargo-deny`'s reach.
Anything that enters the repository as an asset - icon SVGs, fonts - is listed here,
with the original licence file kept at `assets/<group>/LICENSE-*`. Adding an asset
follows the same approval procedure as a dependency, and an asset PR has to update
this section.

Only what is **between the two markers below** is hand-written.
`cargo xtask licenses` preserves that region verbatim, and `--check` does not compare
it.

<!-- assets:begin -->
| Asset | Source | Licence | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lucide Icons 1.39.0 subset (78 SVGs) | https://lucide.dev | ISC | `assets/icons/LICENSE-lucide` |
| Noto Sans KR v39 subset (Regular, Bold — Hangul, Latin, symbols; 14,329 glyphs) | https://fonts.google.com/noto/specimen/Noto+Sans+KR | OFL-1.1 | `assets/fonts/LICENSE-OFL-NotoSansKR` |

`assets/icons/*.svg` are taken unchanged from npm `lucide-static@1.39.0` and saved under
our own names (the name mapping is in `assets/icons/MAPPING.md`). The
original licence file carries both the full ISC text and the full MIT text that applies to
the icons inherited from Feather (`arrow-left`, `check`, `chevron-*`, `clock`, `info`,
`key`, `lock`, `minus`, `monitor`, `moon`, `plus`, `power`, `search`, `trash-2`, `x` and
others) - both are preserved verbatim in `assets/icons/LICENSE-lucide`.

`cargo xtask icons` turns those SVGs into `crates/fairing-widgets/src/icons/generated.rs`.
What ships is the generated code; the SVGs stay in the repository. The `fairing-widgets`
package carries the same licence file as `LICENSE-lucide`, next to the generated geometry.

`assets/brand/` (the manta mark and the abyss backgrounds) and `assets/kiosk/` (the kiosk
example's pictures) are not third-party, so they are not in the table: both were made for this
project with a generative image model and are distributed under the MIT licence, like the
code. Their provenance notes are in `assets/brand/README.md` and `assets/kiosk/SPEC.md`.
<!-- assets:end -->
